content: Our model is a variation of SAN BIBREF1 , as shown in Figure FIGREF2 . The main difference is the additional binary classifier added in the model justifying whether the question is unanswerable. Roughly, the model includes two different layers: the shared layer and task specific layer. The shared layer is almost identical to the lower layers of SAN, which has a lexicon encoding layer, a contextual layer and a memory generation layer. On top of it, there are different answer modules for different tasks. We employ the SAN answer module for the span detector and a one-layer feed forward neural network for the binary classification task. It can also be viewed as a multi-task learning BIBREF8 , BIBREF5 , BIBREF9 . We will briefly describe the model from ground up as follows. Detailed descriptions can be found in BIBREF1 .
